request.style: English, hymn, male solo with choir, organ, strings, cello, piano, hopeful and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He did not enter year by year
With blood that was not his own
No endless suffering for us
Since the foundation of the world

[Chorus]
He will appear a second time
Not to deal with sin again
But to bring salvation now
To those who wait for him

[Verse]
He appeared once for all
At the culmination of ages
To do away with sin
By the sacrifice of himself

[Chorus]
He will appear a second time
Not to deal with sin again
But to bring salvation now
To those who wait for him

[Bridge]
We die once and face judgment
As it is appointed for us
But his offering bears the sins
Of many who look to him

[Chorus]
He will appear a second time
Not to deal with sin again
But to bring salvation now
To those who wait for him

[Outro]
He will appear a second time
To bring salvation to us
